plan.architecture_summary: MonsoonPay cross-cloud checkout orchestrates traffic in AWS ap-south-1 through Envoy proxies fronting Spanner Omni backed by Software TrueTime (<3ms drift). The circuit_breaker.py module models Envoy pending-request queue saturation and remedies the legacy 64-slot synchronous retry storm (p99=430ms) by expanding max_envoy_pending_requests to 512, applying jittered exponential backoff (max_retries=2, base_backoff_ms=4.0), and failing open into local Spanner Omni bounded stale reads (<15ms) when consecutive saturation breaches failure_threshold.
plan.risk_assessment: 1. Benchmark Blind Spot: benchmark_policy peaks at 184 concurrent requests while SHIPPED_SWARM_POLICY sets max_envoy_pending_requests=512, meaning saturation, jittered retries, and OPEN/HALF_OPEN stale-read fallbacks are never exercised under the patched policy test. 2. Checkout Write-Path Integrity: Serving bounded stale reads during BreakerState.OPEN on checkout commits risks double-spend or stale inventory authorization unless strictly scoped to idempotent read-only pre-checks. 3. Half-Open Flapping & Retry Accounting: HALF_OPEN does not immediately re-open on single probe failure if consecutive_failures was reset, max_retries is unused in latency calculation, and modulo-based probe transitions (fallback_reads % 4) lack time-based cooldowns under high concurrency.
